crystal_multiplier.configuration.machine: Crystal Multiplier (machine)
Base energy multiplier
Global factor on the energy cost of every operation.
Base speed multiplier
Global base speed multiplier of every recipe.
Config layout version
Layout version of this file, used by future config migrations. Do not edit by hand.
Disable the auto generated recipes
When enabled this mod injects no recipe at all: only the hand written json recipes (certus quartz, charged certus quartz, fluix) and any datapack recipe remain. Off by default.
Crystals per parallel lane
How many crystals of one kind form one parallel lane.
Default energy per tick (generated recipes)
Energy per tick of the recipes this mod generates in code for crystals found by scanning the item registry. Hand written json recipes keep their own values.
Default ticks per operation (generated recipes)
Base duration of one operation of a generated recipe, before tier speed and baseSpeedMultiplier are applied.
Maximum parallel lanes
Upper bound of parallel lanes per machine.
Upgrade multiplier
Base factor of the Mekanism upgrade maths: value ^ (cards / cards possible). Default 10 = Mekanism default.
Per item recipe overrides
One line per item, format modid:item=energy:ticks, e.g. appflux:redstone_crystal=400:200. Overrides the generated numbers for that item; broken lines are ignored and logged.
This machine: eject products every tick
When enabled the Crystal Multiplier pushes its output slots into adjacent containers / pipes every tick instead of Mekanism's default 10 tick interval. Crafting speed is not affected. On by default.
Push products into the AE network

When enabled the machine first pushes everything in its output slots into the ME network of the AE2 cable / interface touching it (the "products return to the network" behaviour of Productive Bees Genesis); whatever the network rejects is left to Mekanism's ejector. Turn it off to use only the side configuration. On by default.
Global: every Mekanism machine ejects products every tick

When enabled every Mekanism machine (own machines, factories, addon machines) pushes its output slots every tick instead of the default 10 tick interval. Crafting speed is not affected. Off by default.
Cards per multiplier step
How many cards of one kind make one full multiplier step; default 8 matches the vanilla per-type cap, addons that raise the cap keep stacking beyond it.
Maximum seed slot capacity
Hard upper bound of the seed slot capacity.
Parallelism, seed slot, speed and energy settings of the Crystal Multiplier.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_seed: The seed is never used up: the machine copies it instead of consuming it.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_parallel: Parallel lanes = seeds / %s (rounded down). Every complete group of %s seeds copies one extra crystal per batch; leftovers are ignored.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_speed_card: Speed cards only add parallel lanes - they do not make a single operation tick faster.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_energy_card: Energy cards only lower the FE per tick - they do not change speed or output.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_eject: Finished items are pushed out of the output slots every tick, straight into the pipe or chest behind the machine.
gui.crystal_multiplier.tip_ae: With an AE2 cable touching the machine the products go straight into the ME network, no interface needed.
